items.reasons: This is a flat front elevation. The top is only a thin 1–2 px blue band with no lit top plane, unlike the original mci-cooler, whose top surface is visible with items on it. A stray tan strip also runs down the left edge of the 4x canvas, outside the cabinet's own outline.

The top is a 1-row dark band, so the shelf unit reads as a dark box seen straight on, with no shelf plank visible from above. The near-black navy fill is much darker than the originals' lit palette. At 1x the bottles blur into pink/teal blobs and don't read as detergent.

Flat front elevation with no visible top plane, and the shelves are thin lines rather than lit planks. The whole unit is a saturated dark green with low contrast, which doesn't match the originals. The green bottles with white blobs and the tan boxes on the bottom shelf turn into a muddy cluster at 1x and 2x.
